title: CPU Decision Reason
description: Rule 3 and Decision 0005: CPU policy may form imperfect estimates from OBSERVABLE evidence only, with explicit confidence and uncertainty. It may never read official cards or know it is 'behind on the cards'. Rule 4: no privileged inputs, no impossible reaction speed, no input reading.

observed_evidence.description: seq references into the OBSERVABLE event stream only. The validator rejects references to sealed events.

belief.description: e.g. 'opponent guard weakening on the left'. Must be phrased from observable evidence.

forbidden_inputs_assertion.description: Explicit machine-checkable assertion carried on every decision record.
